description: Source code for GPIO driver for Infineon CAT1 MCU family, including configuration, port control, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting direction and pull-up/down resistors.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the current input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins simultaneously based on a mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific GPIO pins high based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific GPIO pins (sets low) based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles the state of GPIO pins based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns the masked pending interrupt status for the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_event_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked on GPIO event, fires registered callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt triggering for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_cat1_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages registration or deregistration of GPIO callbacks.
